scripts.setup: npm run setup:web && npm run setup:api
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:api:dev: cd backend && venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test:coverage: mkdir -p reports && cd backend && venv/bin/python -m pytest --cov=main --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=json:../reports/coverage.json
